subject: math
title: Place value to a million
canDo: I can read, write and split whole numbers up to a million.

subject: math
title: Rounding whole numbers
canDo: I can round whole numbers to the nearest 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000 or 100,000.

subject: math
title: Tenths and hundredths
canDo: I can explain the value of each digit in a number with two decimal places.

subject: math
title: Comparing and ordering decimals
canDo: I can compare and order decimals with up to two decimal places.

subject: math
title: Rounding decimals
canDo: I can round a decimal to the nearest whole number or to one decimal place.

subject: math
title: Multiplying and dividing by 10, 100 and 1,000
canDo: I can multiply and divide whole numbers and decimals by 10, 100 and 1,000.

subject: math
title: Negative numbers
canDo: I can order negative numbers and count steps across zero.

subject: math
title: Number sequences
canDo: I can continue a sequence and describe its term-to-term rule.

subject: math
title: Mental addition and subtraction
canDo: I can add and subtract in my head by rounding and adjusting.

subject: math
title: Written addition and subtraction
canDo: I can add and subtract large numbers using columns.

subject: math
title: Multiples and factors
canDo: I can find factors, multiples, common factors and common multiples.

subject: math
title: Prime numbers and square numbers
canDo: I can tell if a number is prime and recognise square numbers.

subject: math
title: Written multiplication
canDo: I can multiply a 4-digit number by a 1-digit number and a 2-digit number by a 2-digit number.

subject: math
title: Written division
canDo: I can divide a number up to 4 digits by a 1-digit number and decide what to do with a remainder.

subject: math
title: Equivalent fractions
canDo: I can find equivalent fractions and write a fraction in its simplest form.

subject: math
title: Comparing fractions and mixed numbers
canDo: I can compare and order fractions and change between improper fractions and mixed numbers.

subject: math
title: Adding and subtracting fractions
canDo: I can add and subtract fractions with the same or related denominators.

subject: math
title: Fractions of amounts
canDo: I can find a fraction of a number, an amount of money or a measurement.

subject: math
title: Adding and subtracting decimals
canDo: I can add and subtract decimals with up to two decimal places.

subject: math
title: Multiplying decimals by whole numbers
canDo: I can multiply a number with one decimal place by a 1-digit whole number.

subject: math
title: Fractions, decimals and percentages
canDo: I can write the same amount as a fraction, a decimal and a percentage.

subject: math
title: Percentages of amounts
canDo: I can find a percentage of an amount, including amounts of money.

subject: math
title: Ratio and proportion
canDo: I can use ratio and proportion to solve problems about groups and recipes.

subject: math
title: The 24-hour clock and timetables
canDo: I can use the 24-hour clock, read a timetable and work out how long something takes.

subject: math
title: Perimeter and area
canDo: I can find the perimeter and area of rectangles and of shapes made from rectangles.

subject: math
title: Angles
canDo: I can name and measure angles and work out angles on a straight line and in a triangle.

subject: math
title: 2D shapes, 3D shapes and nets
titleId: Bangun datar, bangun ruang, dan jaring-jaring
canDo: I can describe the properties of 2D and 3D shapes and recognise the net of a cube.

subject: math
title: Coordinates, translation and reflection
canDo: I can read and plot coordinates and translate or reflect a point on a grid.

subject: math
title: Mode, median, range and charts
canDo: I can find the mode, median and range of data and read bar charts and graphs.

subject: math
title: Probability
canDo: I can describe how likely an event is and list the possible outcomes.
